Perfect! I have enough material. Here's a fun, entirely fictional, satirical rap battle script inspired by the real 2016 debate moments. This is purely creative political satire! 🎤

---

# 🎤 THE 2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 🎤
### *"Bars of Democracy"*
**Hofstra University | September 26, 2016**
**Moderator: Lester Holt**

---

*[A DJ booth replaces the moderator's desk. Red, white, and blue lasers sweep the stage. Lester Holt walks out in a suit with a fresh pair of Jordans.]*

**LESTER HOLT:**
Good evening, America, welcome to the show,
Two candidates, one stage, only one can go.
No podiums tonight, just a mic and a beat,
The first Presidential Rap Battle — let's turn up the heat.
To my left, from New York, a businessman supreme,
Please welcome Donald Trump to drop his campaign theme!
And to my right, former Secretary of State,
Hillary Clinton — let's see if she's truly great!

*[Crowd goes wild. Trump struts in wearing his signature red tie. Hillary walks in wearing a pantsuit with a fresh pair of Air Forces.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** Candidates, the topic is the **economy and jobs**. You each have 90 seconds. Mr. Trump — you have the floor.

---

🎤 **TRUMP** *(beat drops — heavy bass)*:
Yo, listen up people, the name's Donald T,
I built more skyscrapers than you'll ever see.
Six hundred million last year, read my disclosure,
While Hillary's campaign is heading for closure.
I'll bring back the jobs, I'll bring back the deals,
Make America great — that's how it FEELS.
NAFTA was a disaster, signed by your man Bill,
Your whole economic plan? — it gives me a CHILL.
I negotiated with the toughest, I've been to the top,
Hillary's been talking for 30 years — when does it STOP?
You say you got a plan? — Girl, put it online,
So ISIS can read it, that strategy is fine?
I've got stamina, I've got the look, I've got the brand,
Time to put a builder in charge of this land!

*[Trump points at crowd. Crowd is split — half cheering, half booing.]*

---

🎤 **HILLARY** *(smooth, methodical beat — think confident jazz-hop)*:
Let's talk about those taxes you refuse to release,
What are you hiding, Donald? — give the people peace.
Maybe you're not as rich as you like to brag,
Or your charitable giving is a total drag.
You say you'll bring back jobs — but here's what's true:
You stiffed an architect who built a building FOR you.
*"Maybe he didn't do a good job"* — that's what you said,
But ask the workers you've underpaid — they want your head.
I've got a detailed plan — go to HillaryClinton.com,
My policies are solid, my record is long.
Thirty years of service, I've been in the room,
While you were firing people on a TV show — *boom.*
I've got the résumé, I've got the know-how,
And America? — I'm ready right now.

*[Hillary does a calm, confident nod. The crowd erupts.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** Round 2! Topic: **Race relations and law and order.**

---

🎤 **TRUMP**:
Stop and frisk — it worked in New York City,
Without law and order everything's gritty.
Inner cities are a disaster, that's a fact,
And Hillary has done nothing — that's her track.
You had 30 years! Where's the result?
Communities are suffering — whose fault?
I'll be the law-and-order president, that's clear,
I got endorsed by ICE — did you hear?
They've never done that before — never, not once,
And you're out here pandering — don't be a dunce.
The birther thing? — Let me set the record straight,
Your campaign started it — I just sealed his fate,
Got Obama's birth certificate — I did that, ME,
Who else gets results like that? — Nobody.

---

🎤 **HILLARY**:
Oh, Donald, Donald — where do I begin?
You've got a "long record of racist behavior" — it's no spin.
You started birtherism, spread the lie for years,
And now you want Black votes while stoking their fears?
Stop and frisk was ruled unconstitutional, son,
You can't just harass communities with a badge and a gun.
I've spent my career fighting for kids and for rights,
While you were out there picking Twitter fights.
You said you "did a good job" forcing Obama's hand —
That's not a flex, Donald, that's not a plan.
And by the way — let's talk about your "presidential look,"
You said I don't have it — then open a book.
I've been in the Situation Room when decisions were made,
You've been in a boardroom watching your empire fade.

*[Crowd: "OHHHHH!" — Hillary smirks and takes a slow sip of water.]*

---

**LESTER HOLT:** Round 3! The moment you've all been waiting for — **free-style closing shots!**

---

🎤 **TRUMP** *(going off-script, beat gets chaotic)*:
You know, I was going to say something really rough,
Something about your family — real tough stuff.
But I'm classy, I held back — that's called restraint,
While you run around acting like a presidential saint.
You've been doing this for 30 years — what's changed?
Nothing. Zero. The whole system's deranged.
Only I can fix it — I alone, it's true,
And Lester, by the way, you're being unfair too.
The microphone's rigged, the system's a sham,
But don't worry, America — here I am.
She doesn't have the look! She doesn't have the stamina!
I've built an empire from Malibu to Savannah!
If she wins I'll call it rigged — mark my words tonight,
Because the only way I lose is if it's not right!

---

🎤 **HILLARY** *(calm, precise — beat is steady and controlled)*:
You know, I sat here and listened to his spiel,
And I've got to say — I know exactly how I feel.
He's going to blame me for everything tonight —
The economy, the weather, even the microphone's slight.
I said earlier, "By the end of this evening, I'll be blamed,"
For everything that happened — even things unnamed.

*[Trump leans into mic: "Why not?"]*

*[Crowd LOSES IT. Hillary waves her hand in the air and laughs.]*

But here's the thing, America — I'm still standing here,
I've been knocked down, counted out, year after year.
They say I'm not warm enough, not likable, too cold,
But I'm the most qualified candidate you've ever been told.
I've got the plans — go to my website, read the facts,
Donald's got promises — I've got receipts and acts.
So when you step in that booth, remember this night,
One of us came prepared — and one came to fight.
I'll be your president — competent and true,
Happy to be here, America — *this one's for you.*

*[Hillary drops the mic — neatly places it back on the stand.]*

---

*[Thunderous applause. Lester Holt shakes his head with a grin.]*

**LESTER HOLT:**
And that's a wrap, America, you've seen the show,
Head to the polls in November — that's how democracies go.
Goodnight from Hofstra — the battle is done,
Who won this rap battle? — November decides who won.

---

🎙️ ***"Bars of Democracy" — paid for by the American sense of humor.***

---

*Disclaimer: This is entirely fictional political satire for entertainment purposes. All "bars" are based on publicly documented debate moments and well-known policy positions from the 2016 campaign.*
